title: Telling Stories
tagline: Telling a story: sequence words and past tenses together.
canDo: You can tell a story in Urdu: what happened, in order, with feeling

grammar.title: Past continuous
grammar.body: Stem + raha/rahi/rahe + tha/thi/the: woh ro rahi thi (she was crying), hum naach rahe the (we were dancing).

grammar.title: Story glue
grammar.body: pehle (first), phir (then), uske baad (after that), lekin (but), kyunke (because), achanak (suddenly), aakhir mein (in the end). Listener noises: sach mein? phir kya hua? haye Allah!

phrases.roman: baraat do ghante der se aayi
phrases.urdu: بارات دو گھنٹے دیر سے آئی
phrases.en: The baraat arrived two hours late
The groom fell off the horse

phrases.note: Guarantees everyone will know by Friday.

phrases.roman: Achha, shaadi kaisi thi? Sab batao
phrases.urdu: اچھا، شادی کیسی تھی؟ سب بتاؤ
phrases.en: So, how was the wedding? Tell me everything
phrases.speaker: nani

phrases.roman: Pehle to baraat do ghante der se aayi
phrases.urdu: پہلے تو بارات دو گھنٹے دیر سے آئی
phrases.en: First, the baraat came two hours late
accept: pehle baraat do ghante der se aayi

phrases.roman: Do ghante! Hamare zamane mein to…
phrases.urdu: دو گھنٹے! ہمارے زمانے میں تو…
phrases.speaker: nani

phrases.roman: Phir dulha ghore se gir gaya!
phrases.urdu: پھر دولہا گھوڑے سے گر گیا!
phrases.en: Then the groom fell off the horse!
accept: phir dulha ghore se gir gaya

phrases.roman: Achanak, dulha ghore se gir gaya!
phrases.urdu: اچانک، دولہا گھوڑے سے گر گیا!
phrases.en: Suddenly, the groom fell off the horse!
accept: achanak dulha ghore se gir gaya

phrases.en: Oh my God! Then what happened?
phrases.speaker: nani

phrases.roman: Sab hans pade, aur Khala ro rahi thi
phrases.urdu: سب ہنس پڑے، اور خالہ رو رہی تھی
phrases.en: Everyone burst out laughing, and Khala was crying
accept: sab hans pade aur khala ro rahi thi

phrases.en: But he was fine, thank God

phrases.roman: Main nahin ro rahi thi! Aankh mein kuch chala gaya tha
phrases.urdu: میں نہیں رو رہی تھی! آنکھ میں کچھ چلا گیا تھا
phrases.en: I was NOT crying! Something got in my eye
phrases.speaker: khala

phrases.roman: Hahaha! Shabnam ki shaadi pe bhi yahi hua tha
phrases.urdu: ہاہاہا! شبنم کی شادی پہ بھی یہی ہوا تھا
phrases.en: Hahaha! The same thing happened at Shabnam's wedding
phrases.speaker: nani

phrases.roman: Aur maine suna hai ke… kisi ko mat batana…
phrases.urdu: اور میں نے سنا ہے کہ… کسی کو مت بتانا…
phrases.en: And I've heard that… don't tell anyone…
accept: maine suna hai ke kisi ko mat batana

phrases.roman: Aakhir mein sab ne biryani khayi aur sab khush the
phrases.urdu: آخر میں سب نے بریانی کھائی اور سب خوش تھے
phrases.en: In the end everyone ate biryani and everyone was happy
accept: aakhir mein sab ne biryani khayi

phrases.roman: Bolo, bolo! Main kisi ko nahin bataungi. Allah qasam
phrases.urdu: بولو، بولو! میں کسی کو نہیں بتاؤں گی۔ اللہ قسم
phrases.en: Tell me, tell me! I won't tell a soul. I swear
phrases.speaker: nani

phrases.roman: Wah. Ab tum kahani suna sakte ho. Asli Urdu mein!
phrases.urdu: واہ۔ اب تم کہانی سنا سکتے ہو۔ اصلی اردو میں!
phrases.en: Wow. Now you can tell a story. In real Urdu!
phrases.speaker: nani

phrases.roman: Pata hai kya hua? Bilal gir gaya!
phrases.urdu: پتا ہے کیا ہوا؟ بلال گر گیا!
phrases.en: Guess what happened? Bilal fell over!
phrases.speaker: khala

phrases.en: Oh my God! Then what happened?
phrases.speaker: nani

lessons.title: Pata hai kya hua?
lessons.blurb: Start a story. Keep them hooked.
lessons.canDo: You can start a story and react to someone else's

teach.tip: The listener's job: say this, often.
Casual. For stories that sound made up (and probably are).

exercises.prompt: Your cousin stops mid-story. Prompt them.

lessons.title: Pehle, phir, aakhir mein
lessons.blurb: Connectors: the glue that turns sentences into a story.
lessons.canDo: You can link events with first, then, but, because, suddenly

teach.tip: Every good wedding story needs one.

lessons.title: The wedding story
lessons.blurb: Past tense, all of it: came, fell, laughed, was crying.
lessons.canDo: You can tell what happened at an event, in order

teach.title: Past continuous: was …ing
teach.info: Stem + raha/rahi/rahe + tha/thi/the: Khala ro rahi thi (Khala was crying), hum naach rahe the (we were dancing). It sets the scene while the main events happen.

teach.tip: This happens at roughly one wedding in five.

exercises.prompt: Type: “The groom fell off the horse”

lessons.title: Gossip
lessons.blurb: Maine suna hai… the language of every family WhatsApp group.
lessons.canDo: You can share (and receive) family gossip

exercises.prompt: Khala says “Kisi ko mat batana.” How many people will know by Friday?

options.feedback: Correct. Including people in other countries.

lessons.title: Mix it up
lessons.blurb: Nani has poured two cups of chai. Warm up for the boss.
lessons.canDo: You can use this unit's phrases without a prompt: you can tell a story in Urdu: what happened, in order, with feeling

teach.title: Nani has poured two cups of chai
teach.info: She wants the whole wedding story, in order, with drama. This is the big one.

exercises.prompt: Khala is on the phone. Say: “Guess what happened?”
Nani is waiting. Say: “in the end”
Type it for the family group: “Khala was crying”

boss.title: The Story for Nani
boss.blurb: Nani missed the wedding. You're telling her everything. In Urdu. Khala is listening.
boss.scene: Nani couldn't go to the baraat (her knees). The next morning she pats the sofa beside her, pours two cups of chai, and says: tell me everything.
boss.canDo: You can tell a whole story in Urdu, in order, to an elder

h.prompt: Finish the story. Or add gossip.

options.reaction: Khala freezes in the doorway. Nani puts her chai down. This is the real story.

end.title: You told the story
end.text: Beginning, middle, end, with past tenses, connectors and drama, in Urdu, to Nani. This is what the whole course was for. She'll repeat it to everyone, slightly improved.
